name: website-design-ultra
description: Token-efficient website design plugin with tiered anti-slop enforcement for copy and visuals, a deterministic copy linter, provider-trace audits for selective skill loading, evidence-led content, responsive recomposition, license-aware typography, validated state contrast, accessible UI patterns, cinematic 3D direction, adaptive runtime quality, and portable rendered verification.

interface.longDescription: Build, audit, and visually verify coherent websites with progressive-disclosure skills for content truth, microcopy, localization, responsive recomposition, licensed typography, semantic color/state contrast, motion, components, cinematic 3D composition, React Three Fiber, WebGPU/TSL, touch interaction, adaptive runtime quality, scroll storytelling, and web-ready assets, plus four on-demand layers for canvas-first experiences: architecture with a parallel DOM layer, multi-pass render graphs, loading choreography, and sound.
defaultPrompt: Design a distinctive, evidence-led, responsive landing page with no slop in the copy.
Audit this frontend for copy slop, visual slop, contrast, and accessibility gaps.
Build and visually verify an accessible immersive 3D product hero.
